title: 第一卷 · 霓虹失名者 / 第一章 1.3 失名档案
description: 原创像素冒险 · 四六级常见词汇与推断练习 · 3 道分段听力题
source: 原创剧情、原创四六级听力风格题，不是考试原文。
audioLabel: 自然英文神经网络配音：星遥 Michelle / 陆川 Brian / 旁白 Christopher / 系统 Guy · 原创非考试原音
itemScene: 档案室的公开终端只剩被篡改的摘要。星遥父亲留下的原始报告藏在离线存储层，普通设备无法辨认。万象系统提示：档案扫描器可以恢复记录结构并交叉核验时间戳。
ending: 档案扫描器恢复了独立证据：身份故障早于实验发生，官方统计严重失实。你坚持先核验、再保护居民隐私，星遥开始把你当作真正的伙伴。
questionNote: 每八句一次听力检查，共三题；首次无字幕，解析在节末显示。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: The archive smells of dust and warm circuits. Most of its terminals have been disconnected.
lines.translation: 档案室里混着灰尘和发热电路的气味。大部分终端都已断开。

lines.speaker: 陈星遥
lines.text: The public report calls my father careless. It says his experiment caused the identity failures.
lines.translation: 公开报告称父亲疏忽大意，说他的实验造成了身份故障。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: A conclusion is not evidence. We need the observations that supported it.
lines.translation: 结论不是证据。我们需要支撑它的原始观测。

lines.speaker: 万象系统
lines.text: Archive scanner activated. Recovering an independent copy from offline storage.
lines.translation: 档案扫描器已激活。正在从离线存储恢复独立副本。

lines.speaker: 陈星遥
lines.text: Look at the dates. These complaints arrived two weeks before his experiment began.
lines.translation: 看看日期。这些投诉在他的实验开始前两周就到了。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Then the failures cannot all be consequences of his work. They were already occurring.
lines.translation: 那故障不可能全是他工作的结果。故障早已在发生。

lines.speaker: 陈星遥
lines.text: The summary removed that detail. Someone wanted readers to blame him instead of the company.
lines.translation: 摘要删掉了这个细节。有人想让读者责怪他，而不是公司。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Save the original files. We should not accuse anyone until we can verify their authenticity.
lines.translation: 保存原始文件。在核实真实性之前，我们不应该指控任何人。

lines.speaker: 万象系统
lines.text: Two sets of records located. Official totals differ from the raw transaction logs.
lines.translation: 发现两组记录。官方总数与原始事务日志存在差异。

lines.speaker: 陈星遥
lines.text: The official version lists only twelve people affected. The raw data contains hundreds.
lines.translation: 官方版本只列出十二名受影响者。原始数据里有几百人。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Could repeated entries explain the difference? We should exclude duplicates before comparing them.
lines.translation: 重复记录能解释差异吗？比较前应该先排除重复项。

lines.speaker: 万象系统
lines.text: Duplicate entries excluded. Three hundred and eighteen distinct residents lost valid identification.
lines.translation: 已排除重复记录。三百一十八名不同居民失去了有效身份。

lines.speaker: 陈星遥
lines.text: So it was not a minor technical fault. Entire families lost access to housing and medical care.
lines.translation: 所以这不是小技术故障。整个家庭失去了住房和医疗服务。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: And reporting a smaller number made the problem seem less serious than it was.
lines.translation: 而报告较小的数字，让问题显得没有实际那么严重。

lines.speaker: 陈星遥
lines.text: My father requested an external investigation. The request was rejected without explanation.
lines.translation: 父亲申请外部调查，却毫无解释地被拒绝了。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Keep that rejection too. It shows the company knew someone had challenged its account.
lines.translation: 那份拒绝也留着。它表明公司知道有人质疑它的说法。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: A photograph falls from a paper folder. Xingyao catches it before it touches the floor.
lines.translation: 一张照片从纸质文件夹滑落。星遥在它落地前接住了它。

lines.speaker: 陈星遥
lines.text: He wrote the storage address on the back. I thought it was just an old family photograph.
lines.translation: 他把存储地址写在背面。我以为它只是一张旧全家福。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: He left a way to check the evidence without relying on the central network.
lines.translation: 他留下了一种不依赖中央网络的证据核验方法。

lines.speaker: 万象系统
lines.text: Independent signatures match. No modification detected in the recovered source files.
lines.translation: 独立签名一致。恢复的源文件未发现修改。

lines.speaker: 陈星遥
lines.text: We should publish everything tonight. People deserve to know why their lives were erased.
lines.translation: 我们今晚就应该全部公开。人们有权知道自己的生活为什么被抹去。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Yes, but remove personal addresses first. Evidence should protect the residents, not expose them.
lines.translation: 是的，但要先删掉个人住址。证据应该保护居民，而不是暴露他们。

lines.speaker: 陈星遥
lines.text: You are right. We can share the figures and verification method while keeping identities private.
lines.translation: 你说得对。我们可以公开数字与核验方法，同时保护个人身份。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: For the first time, she places the photograph beside my hand instead of hiding it in her coat.
lines.translation: 她第一次把照片放到我的手边，而不是藏回大衣。

questions.prompt: What weakens the official explanation of the failures?
options: Complaints appeared before the experiment began.
Her father refused to provide a summary.
questions.explanation: 投诉早于实验开始两周，削弱了“实验导致全部故障”的因果解释。

questions.prompt: What does the system establish after removing duplicates?
options: Every transaction in the database was false.
questions.explanation: 排除重复项后仍有318名不同居民失去身份，并非重复记录造成数字差异。

questions.prompt: What does Lu Chuan recommend before publishing the evidence?
options: Waiting for the central network to approve it.
questions.explanation: 陆川支持公开，但要求先去掉个人住址，避免伤害受影响居民。
